config.description: Operation config. generate_profiles takes the same keys as the panel: settings, generate_name, generate_photo, photo_source, photo_category, photo_gender, omit_last_name, safe_mode, apply_to_telegram, generation_prompt, generate_username. To set EXACT usernames pass username_pool: ["name1", "name2"] — handed out to account_ids in order, one each. Names and bios take the same pools: name_pool: [{"first_name": "...", "last_name": "..."}] (or custom_first_name/custom_last_name for all), bio_pool: ["..."] (or custom_bio for all). Own avatars: photo_source: "upload" + generate_photo: true + custom_photo_pool_base64: ["data:image/jpeg;base64,..."] (custom_photo_base64 for a single one). Or use the photo library with photo_source: "library" + photo_category / photo_gender. Pool order is sequential for usernames and bios, random for names and photos — pass <pool>_distribution: "sequential" to change it. per_account_plan: {"<account_id>": {"name_override": {"first_name": "...", "last_name": "..."}, "bio_override": "..."}} still works for explicit per-account values. appeal_spamblock REQUIRES appeal_text (30..2000 chars) — the free-form text @SpamBot's supervisor reads. The check ops need nothing. set_2fa: {password (>= 8 chars) | auto_generate: true (unique password per account, returned ONCE in generated_passwords), hint, current_password} — with current_password it CHANGES an existing password, without it sets one on accounts that have none (others are skipped). privacy: {settings: {"last_seen" | "phone_number" | "profile_photo" | "forwards" | "calls" | "groups" | "voice_messages": "everyone" | "contacts_only" | "nobody", "mute_notifications": "on" | "off"}}. leave_chats: {leave_type: "groups" | "channels" | "folders", delay_min, delay_max (seconds between leaves)} — leaves ALL chats of that type, not only the ones joined by tasks. reset_sessions needs no config but top-level confirm: true.

chain.description: Message items sent in order to each target. Shapes: {"type": "text", "text"}; {"type": "photo"|"video"|"gif"|"voice"|"document", "media_url", "text" (caption, optional)}; {"type": "video_note", "media_url"}; media_url is a public http(s) link or "gg-media:<media_id>" for a file uploaded via POST /api/v1/media/ (needed for voice and video_note); {"type": "inline_bot", "post_id"} sends a post with URL buttons via the GramGPT inline bot. post_id is the UUID of an Inline post saved in the panel (DM broadcaster, message type «Inline-пост»). Add "bot_username" (e.g. "PostBot" or the client's own bot) to send via a third-party inline bot instead: post_id is then the inline query, the first result is sent; {"type": "forward", "post_link"} forwards a channel/group post (t.me/<channel>/<id> or t.me/c/<id>/<id>) with the "Forwarded from" header — the account must see the source.

send_mode.description: direct — send the whole chain now; trigger — wait for a reply.

config.description: Module config. Required inside it: `send_mode` (direct|trigger) and `chain` (list of message items; or `chain_variants`). Knobs: work_mode, max_messages, concurrent_sends, greeting (trigger mode), min_delay_seconds / max_delay_seconds / unwarmed_pace_factor, accountProtectionEnabled / accountProtectionLevel, plus the schedule and daily-plan keys below. Waiting (schedule, daily plan, followups) is bounded by the task lifetime of 48 h; a multi-day campaign is relaunched daily.

accountProtectionEnabled.description: Enable AI Account Protection (requires the paid module).

unwarmed_pace_factor.description: Auto-throttle for accounts younger than 14 days: the pause between targets is multiplied by this (default 2.0). Pass 1 to disable it and keep the delays exactly as given.

start_at.description: ISO-8601: the task waits until then before the first send.

stop_at.description: ISO-8601: no new targets after it; the task ends.

active_hours_end.description: Working window end hour 1-24, exclusive; 22→6 = overnight.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the schedule and of the daily plan (default Europe/Moscow).

daily_limit_per_account.description: New targets per account per day. On reaching it the task waits for the next day instead of failing. Replies and followups don't count.

daily_limit_total.description: New targets per day across all accounts of the task.

ramp.description: {start, step_per_day, max}: per-account daily limit = start + step_per_day × account age in days, capped by max.

followups.description: [{after_hours, if: "no_reply", chain}] — nudge those who did not reply, from the same account in the same dialog. after_hours counts from the previous touch, max 47.

chain_variants.description: [{weight, chain}] — A/B test: each target gets one weighted variant; its index (from 0) is in history.variant and in dm.received.variant.

skip_already_messaged.description: Skip targets any of your accounts already messaged (default true).

skip_contacted_days.description: Same dedup limited to the last N days.

notify_on_reply.description: Ping the owner in the GramGPT Telegram bot on a target's first reply.
